tr_caveat: config.py defines no TR and the .mat headers carry no acquisition metadata; compare_pre_post.py hard-codes TR=2.0. All Hz/second columns are conditional on --tr and must be re-derived once the acquisition TR is confirmed.
identifiability_note: K is a single shared operator per model. The operator-level pre/post contrast is n=1 model per condition and is DESCRIPTIVE. Inference is available only on condition-level mode energetics under a fixed operator, with subject as the unit of replication.
